name: Al-Shadhili
role: Founder of the Shadhili Sufi order
contribution: An influential Moroccan Islamic scholar and Sufi, founder of the Shadhili Sufi order.

checks.lead: Abu al-Hasan al-Shadhili (Arabic: أبو الحسن الشاذلي) (full name: Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār al-Ḥasanī wal-Ḥusaynī al-Shādhilī) also known as Sheikh al-Shadhili (593–656 AH) (1196–1258 AD) was an influential Moroccan Islamic scholar and Sufi, founder of the Shadhili Sufi order.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
